verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents an async parameter on its search endpoints that submits a search without holding the HTTP connection open, with results retrieved later through the Searches Archive API. That satisfies the 'asynchronous jobs' branch of the story as a first-party capability. Missing for 10: no documented multi-query batch submission endpoint, no detail on async throughput or concurrency limits for high-volume workloads, no independent or hands-on corroboration of async at scale.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can submit batched or asynchronous jobs for high-volume query workloads

citations.quote: It can be set to `false` (default) to open an HTTP connection and keep it open until you got your search results, or `true` to just submit your search to SerpApi and retrieve them later.
